podcast.body: This song was only a number 43 hit in the UK but soared to number eight in America, showcasing MTV's profound impact on the US chart. Its video was described as "full on resplendent technicolor," driving the music's visual appeal for American audiences. "Iran, only a number 43 hit in their homeland, made it all the way to number eight in America."
